title: Guardian Local Effect Carrier Tensor v1
summary: Task-grounded entity and gripper interaction representation on fresh real multi-view executions; SC46 produced a large relative but sub-gate gain.

mechanisms.name: Local Effect Carrier Tensor
mechanisms.description: Grounds task entities and the robot gripper in three start/end views, encodes global, entity-local, and joint interaction-region state changes, adds explicit region geometry, learns fixed probabilities from source-native training, and delegates final authority to localization eligibility plus a split-conformal singleton reducer.
inputs: Task and subtask text, three start/end RGB viewpoints, disjoint source-native training/calibration labels.
outputs: Execution success, failure, or UNKNOWN plus an 80-dimensional local effect tensor and calibrated probabilities.
mechanisms.limitations: SC46 missed its frozen absolute and failure-recall gates. Detection availability was not limiting; confidence/count features dominated intended state deltas, and translation-object failures remained weak. Do not retune the consumed split or infer arrival/completion authority.
